{{Top}}
'''Blue Twelve''' was the callsign of the twelfth member of [[Blue Squadron]].

During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Evacuation of Hoth]], [[Kulbart Zamoon]] used this call sign.<ref name="SWI146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Twelve was mentioned in the novelization of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but that that pilot's squadron was named [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] in the film. The character [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]] was later named [[Red Twelve/Legends|Red Twelve]].
